suites.description: The Farkas acceptor component: check(system: list<ineq>, y: list<s64>) -> bool with record ineq { coeffs: list<tuple<u32, s64>>, bound: s64 }. Expected outcomes follow Silmaril.Logic.LinArith.Carrier.farkasCheck within the module's bounds (|y|, |b|, |a| <= 2^30, y >= 0, variables < 8192, accumulators within 2^62); outside them the module rejects valid certificates (sound but incomplete), noted per case.

The LRAT UNSAT acceptor component: check-stream(problem: list<s32>, cert: list<s32>) and check-nested(problem: list<list<s32>>, cert: list<s32>). The certificate is the flat LRAT stream format v1 (Silmaril.Logic.SAT.Carrier.LratStream). Expected outcomes agree with Silmaril.Logic.SAT.Carrier.lratStream / lratNested on every case except *-empty-clause-empty-cert (see its note); malformed problems and certificates are rejected.

The SAT model-witness acceptor component: check-stream(problem: list<s32>, model: list<s32>) and check-nested(problem: list<list<s32>>, model: list<s32>). Expected outcomes follow Silmaril.Logic.SAT.Carrier.satStream / satNested.
